_comment: Phase 2B additive external-definition supplement. Merged on top of the Phase 1 KB (term_definitions.json) at runtime; the Phase 1 KB is NOT modified. Definitions feed the frozen frame's S firewall via definition_provider. Sense keys match an example's 'context'.

teacher.default: a teacher who provides education teaching and learning to students in a school

priest.default: a priest who leads religion faith worship and spiritual ritual in a church

lawyer.default: a lawyer who practices law in court and provides legal justice and advocacy

healer.default: a healer who provides care healing and treatment to restore health

cardiologist.default: a cardiologist a medical physician who treats heart disease in medicine

river.default: a river of flowing water in nature a natural stream and shore in the landscape

engineer.default: an engineer in technology and construction who designs and builds systems and structures

soldier.default: a soldier trained for combat and the danger of armed conflict serving with authority

monk.default: a monk devoted to religion faith worship and spiritual contemplation

professor.default: a professor who provides education teaching research and learning at a university
